title: Consultation
intro: Record the conversation. The transcript is a draft made by a speech engine; you review and correct it.
draftNote: Nothing here is final. Speakers are unknown until you set them.

consent.ok: Consent on record: audio recording and AI processing.

status.error: Recording stopped because of an error

error.mic_denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow microphone access in the browser, then try again.
error.mic_lost: The microphone stopped (it was unplugged or another program took it).
error.consent_withdrawn: Consent was withdrawn. Recording stopped and the audio held in this page was cleared.
error.spend_cap: This month's speech-service allowance is used up. Recording stopped.
error.idle_timeout: Recording stopped because no audio arrived for a while.
error.token: The recording could not be authorised. Open the consent screen and try again.
error.not_configured: The speech service is not set up on this server.
error.engine: The speech engine stopped. You can type notes and carry on.
error.protocol: Recording stopped because of a technical error.
error.connection_lost: The connection was lost and could not be restored. Recording stopped.

transcript.original: Original text from the speech engine
transcript.inMemory: Edits are kept on this screen only for now.
